sample_unit: expert raters (4 patient education materials evaluated)

links.outcome: Readability and understandability of AI-generated prehabilitation patient education versus NHS leaflet
links.effect: ChatGPT readability comparable to NHS leaflet; PEMAT-P understandability >75% for all materials; actionability highest for NHS (93.3%). Expert accuracy lower for all AI models than NHS (9.8 ± 0.3).
links.quote: For readability, ChatGPT and the National Health Service were comparable.

unlisted_practices: Hybrid human-in-the-loop production of patient education materials (recommended, not tested)
Comparing AI-generated patient education content with an established human-authored leaflet on accuracy, readability, sentiment, and actionability

screen.reason: Expert evaluation of LLM-generated patient education materials compared against an existing NHS leaflet on prehabilitation.
